ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (dark gray/black) with low macro-level contrast; high-intensity pixels are limited to localized circular scarring and distal tips, representing approximately 5% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base with discrete, high-contrast light-colored circular rings (approximately 5-15 pixel diameters) scattered across both lobes, with higher density visible on the right lobe medial section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 135 degrees and a depth occupying roughly 10% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth pattern with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular ring clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the ventral surface, particularly concentrated in the central-right lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced textured encrustations and high-intensity pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with external organic colonization.
